description: Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normalized, with title and word count. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
